name: Captain James Alexander Upton
citation: Awarded Military Cross for conspicuous gallantry during the Battle of the Somme. Led his company through heavy machine gun fire near Thiepval Wood.

name: Sergeant William John Patterson
citation: Mentioned in Despatches for extraordinary bravery in maintaining field communications under direct artillery barrage at Ypres.

name: Corporal Thomas Henry Loughridge
citation: Fell during the Normandy Campaign while securing vital bridgehead crossings near Caen. Remembered with pride on the Bayeux Memorial.

name: Leading Aircraftman Robert Vance
citation: Served with Coastal Command protecting Atlantic convoys. Maintained Radar systems across northern air bases.

name: Private Edward Gibson
citation: Demonstrated steadfast courage at Messines Ridge. Wounded in action and returned to Templepatrick after victory.

name: Staff Sergeant David Millar
citation: Awarded General Service Medal. Served two decades protecting local communities across County Antrim with unwavering dedication.

name: Sister Margaret Campbell
regiment: Queen Alexandra's Imperial Military Nursing Service
citation: Rendered essential medical service in field hospitals across North Africa and Italy, caring for wounded Allied servicemen.

name: Lieutenant Samuel Bell
citation: Defended airspace during the Blitz and served in the Western Desert Campaign. Recognized for cool leadership under fire.
